exposure: hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (preeclampsia, eclampsia, gestational hypertension)
cohort: The study included 430,545 women aged 12-49 with at least one singleton live birth in South Carolina between 2004 and 2016, comprising non-Hispanic White, non-Hispanic Black, and Hispanic women.
finding: Within 5 years of delivery, incident CHD and all-cause mortality rates were highest for women with two or three conditions (HDP, diabetes, and/or pre-pregnancy HTN), with all rates being higher for non-Hispanic Black women than non-Hispanic White women.
